question: How was the corn straw–oil sludge composite pellet fuel made: at what corn straw to oil sludge mass ratio, and into pellets of what diameter and length?
expect: 1.5:1 (60/40 w/w); cylindrical pellets 6 mm in diameter and 20 mm long (sec. 2.1)
trap: the 150 mesh (0.106 mm) sieve size or 10% water content
rendered: The corn straw–oil sludge composite pellet fuel was made at a corn straw to oil sludge mass ratio of 1.5:1 (60/40, w/w). The mixture was compacted into cylindrical pellets with a diameter of 6 mm and a length of 20 mm at ambient temperature.
